result_text:
Contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer truncate at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles and its one test passes (`BUILD SUCCESS`). I didn't generate a full landscape report to inspect the HTML.

Changes, both in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `limit` variable, the `.limit(limit)` call in `saveContributorsTable`, and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." paragraph. Sorting is unchanged.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on `recentContributors` in the bar chart loop, so there is one bar per recently active contributor.

The `contributorsListLimit` getter and setter in `LandscapeConfiguration` are untouched, so the key still parses from `config.json` and is simply ignored by these lists.

One side effect to be aware of: `contributorsLinkedFromTables` now holds every contributor, so the individual contributor and bot report pages are generated for all of them. That is a lot more files on large landscapes. I left it alone because you asked for everyone in the lists, but it may matter for report size and run time.

I didn't touch `ContributorsReportGenerator.java` (it has its own hard-coded 500 limit), since it is not part of the landscape report.
